-- The queries of the orders.  Their output is models, set by this folder's sqlsource.json, so each gets a model of
-- its parameters and one of its rows, from its entry in Orders.sql.json.  The parameters are in camelCase, which Dapper
-- binds to the properties of the input model.

-- name: GetOrder
-- summary: One order and the name of its customer.
SELECT
    o.id,
    o.status,
    o.placed_at,
    o.shipped_at,
    u.name AS customer_name
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.id = @orderId;

-- name: ListOrderTotals
-- summary: The total of each order.
SELECT
    o.id,
    sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN order_lines AS l ON o.id = l.order_id
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

-- name: CountShippedOrders
-- summary: How many orders of each user have shipped.
SELECT
    u.id,
    count(o.shipped_at) AS shipped
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY u.id;

-- name: ListUserDisplayNames
-- summary: The name of each user with each word capitalized.
-- column: display_name not null
SELECT
    u.id,
    initcap(u.name) AS display_name
FROM users AS u
ORDER BY u.id;

-- name: GetOrderTags
-- summary: The tags of one order.
SELECT
    o.id,
    o.tags
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.id = @orderId;
